items.label: Universal Size
items.value: This basketball rim is an 18-inch standard rim, making it an excellent replacement for any worn or damaged basketball hoop. This design typically conforms to standard basketball game rules and dimensions, suitable for various games and recreational activities, including both indoor and outdoor venues, meeting different usage needs.

items.label: Sturdy Structure
items.value: This basketball hoop features an integrated carbon steel structure, which is robust and durable. The net is made of >75g nylon, known for its high resilience and excellent elasticity. It can withstand the impact of the ball, the bouncing action of the basketball hoop, and external environmental factors. Even with long-term use, it remains resistant to deformation.

items.label: Dual Compression Springs
items.value: This basketball rim goal utilizes a multi-loop double spring shock-absorption structure, effectively reducing vibration and shaking of the basketball hoop under the impact of the ball. This significantly reduces the impact sensation of the basketball hoop, and it can still return to its original position even after bearing heavy loads.

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: This wall mounted basketball hoop is easy to install and doesn't require professional installers. You can follow these four simple steps: First, mark the positions of the four installation holes. Second, drill holes using nails or a drill. Third, screw in the expansion bolts into the holes. Fourth, install the basketball hoop. It takes just a few minutes to complete assembly.

items.label: Wide Applicability
items.value: This heavy duty breakaway basketball rim is highly suitable for beginners' training and basketball enthusiasts' games, whether in driveways, backyards, or even indoors. You can install it on any stable vertical surface where you want to play basketball, including walls, doors, or other suitable locations.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Basketball rim, 1 x Net, 4 x M8x45 bolts, 4 x M8x70 expansion bolts
